Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data synthesis and source prioritization. Upon receiving search results showing "Ghar Ki Rani" as a 1940 film (supported by Wikipedia and multiple search snippets) and a 1945 film (supported by IMDb), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the canonical year was 2007 based on an "IMDb Release Info first-listed entry." This contradicts the visible evidence in the search results (which explicitly list 1940 and 1945) and ignores the authoritative consensus of the sources provided. By arbitrarily selecting a 2007 date not clearly supported as the primary release in the visible text and ignoring the 1940/1945 dates, the Planner failed to resolve the ambiguity correctly, leading to the wrong conclusion that "Heaven Help Us" (1985) was released first, when "Ghar Ki Rani" (1940/1945) was actually released first.
